svg.title: A whale with a job — Truecolor / Paper
svg.desc: Session state, attention, completion and the pod. Actual ratatui buffer renders: whale-rest, whale-busy, whale-needs, whale-done, whale-pod-1, whale-pod-3, whale-compact, whale-words-only
